name: Mango Pickle
description: A tangy and spicy Kerala-style mango pickle made from farm-fresh raw mangoes, cold-pressed gingelly oil, and hand-ground spices—naturally cured and free from additives.

name: Lime Pickle
description: A tangy, gut-friendly Kerala-style lime pickle made with fresh limes, cold-pressed oils, and no preservatives—pure, wholesome, and packed with authentic flavor.

name: Garlic Pickle
description: A bold and flavorful Kerala-style garlic pickle made with sun-cured cloves, cold-pressed gingelly oil, and traditional spices—naturally fermented for rich taste and health benefits.

name: Fish Pickle
description: A healthy, homemade Kerala-style fish pickle made with fresh fish, cold-pressed gingelly oil, and natural spices—rich in protein, omega-3s, and free from artificial preservatives.

name: Meat Pickle
description: A bold and protein-rich Kerala-style beef pickle made with slow-cooked beef, cold-pressed gingelly oil, and hand-ground spices—naturally fermented and free from additives.

name: Ginger Pickle (Puli Inji)
description: A sweet, spicy, and tangy Kerala-style ginger pickle (puli inchi) made with fresh ginger, tamarind, jaggery, and traditional spices—naturally preserved and great for digestion.

name: Wild Lemon and Dates Pickle
description: A bold and aromatic Kerala-style pickle made with wild lemon (vadukapuli), juicy dates, and traditional spices—offering a perfectly balanced burst of tangy, sweet, and spicy flavors.

name: Pineapple Pickle
description: A sweet, spicy, and tangy Kerala-style pineapple pickle made with ripe pineapples, traditional spices, and cold-pressed gingelly oil—naturally fermented for a tropical, gut-friendly twist.

name: Prawns Pickle
description: A flavorful, homemade Kerala-style prawns pickle made with fresh prawns, cold-pressed sesame oil, and traditional spices—rich in protein, naturally preserved, and free from additives.

name: Chicken Pickle
description: A spicy and tangy Kerala-style chicken pickle made with lean chicken, cold-pressed gingelly oil, and traditional spices—naturally preserved, protein-rich, and free from additives.

name: Lime and Dates Pickle
description: A uniquely flavorful Kerala-style pickle made with sun-cured limes, juicy dates, and traditional spices—perfectly balancing tangy, sweet, and spicy notes in every bite.

name: Gooseberry Pickle
description: A tangy and spicy Kerala-style gooseberry pickle (nellikka achar) made with fresh amla, cold-pressed sesame oil, and traditional spices—rich in antioxidants and bursting with bold flavor.
